items.label: Applied Digital Q4 FY2026 (07-27-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Power: Base Electron, an independent power producer in which Applied Digital owns

set.signal: Power: Base Electron, an independent power producer in which Applied Digital owns approximately 10%, is developing roughly 1.2 GW of front-of-the-meter, on-grid natural gas-fired generation in the Dakotas (collaborating with Babcock & Wilcox and regional utilities); CEO: initial capacity is timed for 2029 and 2030 and then continues to ramp, and 'we're working on another project there in a different part of the state as well'. The generation goes through the utilities Applied Digital already works with and serves its campuses as well as other retailers on the regional system. CEO: Applied Digital has a lot to build for 2026, 2027 and some 2028, after which additional power capacity (Base Electron plus other regional generation and transmission projects, including a JETx line between Ellendale and Jamestown that will expand Ellendale power capacity) should let it expand all of its campuses, which all go north of a gigawatt. At Polaris Forge 1, use of excess regional grid capacity has returned more than $45 million in electricity credits to local ratepayers.

items.reason: The CEO says 'We're working on another project there in a different part of the state' (speaker's 'we'); the entry attributed that project to Base Electron, which the source does not state.
items.evidence: This is all front-of-the-meter on-grid capacity. We're working on another project there in a different part of the state as well. These will go with the utilities that we work with already.
